learning_outcomes.text: Create data models on spreadsheets, using appropriate design tools for each case.
Know how to select and visualize relevant data in different formats.
Use the main mathematical, statistical, logical, and lookup functions in different table and chart formats.
Use data security and protection tools.
Analyze data from the results obtained by executing different formulas, functions, and charts.
Create macros and dashboards to manage and analyze data agilely.
Create well-formed text documents using word processing tools.
Create well-formed presentations using data presentation tools.

syllabus_topics: Handling references in formulas and functions
Working with advanced word processing tools
Information Technologies in the Company for Information Presentation
teaching_methods: Team work (preparation of essays, problem-solving, projects, etc. for practical classes)
Individual study (preparation of readings, exams, exercises, class preparation)
assessment_rules: The final grade is the sum of scores from academic assignments (20%), assessment activity (15%), final exam (40%), and integrated project (25%). A minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required on the final exam; otherwise, the course is failed. A minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required for all four components, except for the assessment activity. Late submissions are penalized, with deductions for delays of up to 3 days (score * 0.7), between 3 and 5 days (score * 0.4), and 6 or more days (score * 0). For the second sitting, only the final exam is retaken, and other partial grades are carried over, with the same grading formula applied.
